import queueing
import worker


# --- api.py: mode validation and propagation -------------------------------

def test_invalid_mode_raises_before_enqueue():
    enqueued = []

    def capture(enqueue_fn):
        def inner(payload):
            enqueued.append(payload)
            return "ok"
        return inner

    # unknown mode must raise ValueError
    for bad in ("remote1", "Remote", "", 1, None, "ALL"):
        enqueued.clear()
        try:
            api.submit("owner", capture(enqueue), mode=bad)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("submit(mode={!r}) did not raise ValueError".format(bad))
        assert not enqueued, "invalid mode was enqueued: {}".format(enqueued)

    # default mode is 'all' and payload carries owner + mode
    result = api.submit("owner", capture(enqueue))
    assert result == "ok"
    assert enqueued == [{"owner": "owner", "mode": "all"}], enqueued

    # each valid mode propagates into the payload
    expected = {"all", "remote", "hybrid", "office"}
    enqueued.clear()
    for mode in expected:
        api.submit("owner", capture(enqueue), mode=mode)
    assert [p["mode"] for p in enqueued] == list(expected)
    assert all(p["owner"] == "owner" for p in enqueued)

    # owner preserved
    api.submit("boss", capture(enqueue), mode="hybrid")
    assert enqueued[-1]["owner"] == "boss"
    assert enqueued[-1]["mode"] == "hybrid"

    # old two-arg call signature still works
    assert api.submit("owner", capture(enqueue)) == "ok"


# --- queueing.py: payload carries owner and mode --------------------------

def test_payload():
    p = queueing.payload("o", "remote")
    assert p == {"owner": "o", "mode": "remote"}
    assert queueing.payload("o")["owner"] == "o" and \
        queueing.payload("o")["mode"] is None


# --- worker.py: filtering by mode ------------------------------------------

def _jobs():
    return [
        {"id": 1, "mode": "remote", "owner": "o"},
        {"id": 2, "mode": "hybrid", "owner": "o"},
        {"id": 3, "mode": "office", "owner": "o"},
        {"id": 4},                        # legacy: mode missing
        {"id": 5, "mode": None},          # legacy: mode None
        {"id": 6, "owner": "o"},          # legacy: no mode key
    ]


def test_all_filter_keeps_everything_in_order():
    jobs = _jobs()
    out = worker.execute({"mode": "all"}, jobs)
    assert out == jobs


def test_all_filter_is_default_and_for_missing_task_mode():
    jobs = _jobs()
    assert worker.execute({}, jobs) == jobs
    assert worker.execute({"mode": None}, jobs) == jobs


def test_remote_filter():
    jobs = _jobs()
    out = worker.execute({"mode": "remote"}, jobs)
    assert [j["id"] for j in out] == [1]


def test_hybrid_filter():
    jobs = _jobs()
    out = worker.execute({"mode": "hybrid"}, jobs)
    assert [j["id"] for j in out] == [2]


def test_office_filter():
    jobs = _jobs()
    out = worker.execute({"mode": "office"}, jobs)
    assert [j["id"] for j in out] == [3]


def test_legacy_jobs_included_for_every_known_filter():
    jobs = _jobs()
    for mode in ("remote", "hybrid", "office"):
        out = worker.execute({"mode": mode}, jobs)
        assert [j["id"] for j in out if j.get("mode") is None] == [4, 5, 6]
        # known mismatches excluded
        assert [j["id"] for j in out
                if j.get("mode") in ("remote", "hybrid", "office")] != \
            set(jobs)


def test_object_identity_and_order_preserved():
    job = {"id": 42, "mode": "remote"}
    jobs = [job, {"id": 1}, {"id": 2, "mode": "remote"}]
    out = worker.execute({"mode": "remote"}, jobs)
    assert out[0] is job
    assert out[2] is jobs[2]
    assert [j["id"] for j in out] == [42, 2]


def test_non_list_jobs_input():
